pokedexEntries.sw: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

pokedexEntries.sh: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

pokedexEntries.sc: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.

pokedexEntries.vi: The sand it spews contains sharp, pointy gravel, which is actually just sand that Sandaconda's saliva has hardened into irregular shapes.
